card.name: Small verbs and linking words mid-clause
card.fires_on: Small linking or modal words such as should, might, for, if, of and expected, placed after a subject and before the main verb or object. Mostly general web prose about what people should do or may happen.

modes.label: Modal verbs
modes.description: Words like should or might right after a subject, leading into an action.
modes.example: the length of time women<< should>> take tamoxifen.

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Short words such as for, if or of that join a subject to what follows.
modes.example: Any student eligible<< for>> and requesting academic accommodations

card.plain: It fires on small helper words in the middle of a sentence, where a verb or object is about to come next.
